standard.summary: 相邻 step relative-L1 误差探针，默认关闭。上游 SmoothCache (arXiv:2411.10510) 是推理期按层表征误差离线标定的 schedule；本仓只有运行时误差阈值与预热步，没有 calibration ⇒ 机制不同。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: A relative-L1 error probe between adjacent steps, off by default. Upstream SmoothCache (arXiv:2411.10510) is an inference-time schedule calibrated offline from per-layer representation error; this repository has only a runtime error threshold and warmup steps, with no calibration => a different mechanism.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: SmoothCache 论文（arXiv:2411.10510）/官方仓库使用 calibration 得到 layer-wise representation-error schedule；本仓只用相邻 step 的 relative-L1 probe 与本地 schedule/store seam，差异明确，不保证论文速度/质量结果。

advanced_en.principle: The SmoothCache paper (arXiv:2411.10510) / official repo uses calibration to derive a layer-wise representation-error schedule; this repo only uses a relative-L1 probe between adjacent steps plus a local schedule/store seam. The difference is explicit and paper speed/quality results are not guaranteed.
